evals.name: Build a page XML parser
evals.description: Test that the skill guides building a page XML parser, including the need for a real export
evals.prompt: I need to build a page XML parser for the CMS so we can round-trip page data with ShopSite. Where do I start?
expected_output: Explains that no page parser exists yet and page XML structure is inferred
References page-xml-structure.md for the inferred structure and page-codebase-gaps.md for current gaps
Recommends starting with a real page XML export from the target store
Outlines the 7 build phases: discovery → parser → schema → normalizer → denormalizer → tests → HTTP client
Cross-references the product-parser.ts pattern for implementation guidance
Warns that root element, DTD, field tags, and relationship field encoding must be confirmed from a real export
Notes the preservation constraints that must be followed

evals.name: Page layout fields reference
evals.description: Test that the skill correctly identifies layout-related page fields
evals.prompt: What page fields control the layout and display of products on a ShopSite page?
expected_output: Lists: Columns, Page Link Columns, Item Alignment, Display column borders?, Page Width, Order, Products Sort Field, Pages Sort Field, Products First, Number Products, Text Wrap, Template
Gives type and default for each field
Notes that XML tag names are inferred and recommends confirming from a real export
Explains what each field does at a high level

evals.name: ProductOnPages current handling
evals.description: Test that the skill explains the current ProductOnPages handling as a preserved-block hack
evals.prompt: How is ProductOnPages currently handled in the codebase? What does that mean for page-product relationships?
expected_output: Explains that ProductOnPages is handled as a preserved advanced block in product XML
References page-codebase-gaps.md for the detailed explanation
Describes the extractPageNames() function in product-denormalizer.ts that parses page names from <Name>/<PageName>/<PageLink> tags
Points out that the CMS can round-trip page assignments but cannot list pages, edit page metadata, or manage assignments from the page side
Notes that Product Links (page-side) is not yet implemented
Recommends exporting a real page XML sample before implementing page-side support
